name: Pause
author: RussoDaFederal
description: This plugin allows you to spawn multiple text boxes with custom properties. To remove a window you spawned with this plugin, use the Remove Picture command. If you display a Picture with the same ID as a custom window, the window will be overwritten, and vice-versa. Use negative IDs for the windows. If you use positive IDs, they'll be drawn on top of other screen elements.

commands.name: Pause
commands.description: Pauses the game, similar to when you open the default menu. Doesn't do anything if the game is already paused.

commands.name: Unpause
commands.description: Unpauses the game if it is paused.

commands.name: Wait
commands.description: Waits a set time. Stops counting when the game is paused.
